Author: Manoj Kumar Tiwari
Bench: Manoj Kumar Tiwari
 Office Notes, reports, orders
Sl.

Date Court'S Or Jud
No and Registrar's order with

Signatures
 02.06.2025
 Crla No. 151 of 2025
 With
 Bail Application No. Ia/1/2025
 Hon'ble Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.
Hon'ble Subhash Upadhyay, J.
Mr. Shivanand Bhatt, Advocate for the appellant.
Mr. J.S. Virk, Deputy Advocate General for the State.
2. This is an appeal against conviction.

By the impugned judgment dated 25.02.2025, passed by Special Judge (POCSO), Pauri Gadhwal in Special Sessions Trial No. 22 of 2022, appellant was convicted for offence punishable under Sections 376, 323, 506 IPC and Section 3/4 of POCSO Act and sentenced to 20 years rigorous imprisonment with fine of Rs. 10,000/-.
3.
As per office report, the appeal is within time.
Objection(s), if any, to the Bail Application be filed in the meantime.

(Subhash Upadhyay, J.) (Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.) 02.06.2025 Mahinder/
CRLA/151/2025 on 2 June, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/153380039/
